summary: Sporting News previews the Week 13 Thursday Night Football game between the Seahawks and Cowboys in Dallas, giving fantasy start/sit advice for both teams. Dallas is a three-field-goal favorite, so most Cowboys (Prescott, Pollard, Lamb, Ferguson, D/ST, Aubrey) are starts while most Seahawks skill players are sits, except WR3-level Metcalf and Lockett. It closes with suggested DraftKings Showdown and FanDuel single-game lineups built around Tony Pollard.
one_line: Fantasy start 'em, sit 'em advice and DFS lineups for Seahawks vs. Cowboys on Week 13 Thursday Night Football, favoring Dallas players.
key_facts: Seahawks at Cowboys opens NFL Week 13 on Thursday Night Football at 8:15 p.m. ET on Amazon Prime Video.
The game total is 47.5 and the Cowboys are favored by three field goals.
Geno Smith has fallen from the top 12 last season to cumulative QB20 in 2023, and the Cowboys have allowed only two strong fantasy QB performances (Brock Purdy and Jalen Hurts).
Zach Charbonnet is a sit after rushing for just 47 yards two straight weeks despite Kenneth Walker III (oblique) being out.
DK Metcalf is WR34 and Tyler Lockett WR32 in half-point PPR this season, versus WR13 and WR18 last season; both are volume-based WR3 starts.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba is a sit with a ceiling of around 50 yards; Noah Fant, Will Dissly, the Seahawks D/ST and kicker Jason Myers are also sits.
Dak Prescott is behind only Josh Allen and Jalen Hurts among fantasy QBs this season after a seven-game stretch, though a '250-and-2' night is expected.
Tony Pollard is a start (about 80 yards and a score projected) because Seattle is in the bottom five in fantasy points allowed to running backs; Rico Dowdle is a sit.
CeeDee Lamb is a start in the slot against Jamal Adams, while Brandin Cooks is a sit against rookie Devon Witherspoon.
Jake Ferguson is a start despite catching four of eight targets for 67 yards and no TDs over the past two weeks against the Commanders and Panthers.
The Cowboys D/ST is the top-scoring fantasy defense with six massive outings, and rookie kicker Brandon Aubrey has been elite.
DraftKings Showdown lineup: Pollard at Captain ($14,700), with Prescott, Lockett, Ferguson, Cowboys D/ST and Smith-Njigba at FLEX.
FanDuel lineup: Pollard at MVP ($14,500), with Prescott, Lockett, Ferguson and Smith-Njigba at AnyFLEX, maxing out the salary.
